name: dev.usetrail/trail
title: Trail
description: Issue tracker and durable project memory for your coding agent, scoped to the folder you open.

environmentVariables.name: TRAIL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Only for a self-hosted Trail. Left unset, the connector points at the hosted service.

environmentVariables.name: TRAIL_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the project name, which otherwise comes from the folder you have open.
